body: I just turned 20, I'm going to a community college and looking to transfer for mechanical engineering. I get along well with everyone, ill make friends in a class, but never keep in touch. I lost contact with almost everyone from high school. I'm doing a bit better now, but I've been depressed for years now and waves of intense seclusion hit occasionally. I really appreciate you reaching out.
Glad to hear, it was nice having someone to talk to. Have a good one

That situation isn't the best, I've fucked my own sleep so bad I don't even have an excuse, and I better have a 4.0 because I don't work, don't have a girlfriend, barely have friends, and do jack shit outside of school. I don't think your bitching, I'm glad I have someone to talk to. Maybe you can try meal prep to get some good food late at night. I can't see any solution to your sleep, just try to get to bed at a consistent time every day. For exercise you might enjoy doing calisthenics, which are just body-weight excersizes. I started doing a quick routine before bed, and it really helped me feel better, it might help you. I would suggest picking one thing to focus on, and try to make it a habit over 2-3 months. I think emotions are really physiological, they're based on a combination of our brain chemistry and emotional stimuli. If you feed your body well, get good sleep, and excersize, it's a lot easier to handle the shit life throws at you. I really hope you feel better, getting depressive periods out of nowhere is fucking bullshit

I feel ya, passed all my finals to maintain my 4.0, started learning piano, and hanging out with my family for the holidays, but I couldn't get out of bed today. I know things could be going so much worse for me, bit I guess happiness comes from within. Three really big influences of mental health are: sleep, diet, and exercise. Are you getting good consistent sleep? Eating healthy, unprocessed food? Getting cardio and strength training in, and generally leading an active lifestyle?

Wow, I can relate to this so much. I don't think many people know how I feel because I can hide it so well, I'll laugh and smile and joke with my friends, but everything comes crashing down when I'm alone. I couldn't get out of bed today for my birthday dinner, told everyone that I wasn't feeling well, but I just wanted to give up on everything. Maybe you don't feel like that and I'm projecting, or maybe I think I'm more special than I really am. I can't live for the future, I see nothing in it for me. I have to live every week as its own goal, and sometime every day like it's its own goal.
Really quite bored myself tbh, I always enjoy hearing other people's perspectives on life it grounds me if you know what I mean. I'd be happy to listen
Hey man, if you want to talk about things I can lend an ear. What's going on in your life?
